name: Dify
description: Open-source LLM app platform with built-in RAG, workflows and agents.
descriptionZh: 开源 LLM 应用平台，内置 RAG、工作流与 Agent。
keyFact: Dify is an open-source LLM application platform open-sourced by LangGenius in May 2023, bundling RAG, visual workflows, agents and 50+ tools; it is not OSI open source — it ships under the 'Dify Open Source License', a modified Apache-2.0 that forbids unauthorized multi-tenant SaaS and requires keeping the logo.
keyFactZh: Dify 是 LangGenius 于 2023 年 5 月开源的大模型应用平台，内置 RAG、可视化工作流、Agent 与 50+ 工具；它并非 OSI 开源——采用「Dify Open Source License」（修改版 Apache-2.0），禁止未经授权的多租户 SaaS 并要求保留 Logo。
caveat: License is a modified Apache-2.0 and is not OSI-approved; GitHub reports it as NOASSERTION. Commercial multi-tenant use requires a commercial license.
caveatZh: 许可证为修改版 Apache-2.0，未经 OSI 认证（GitHub 标注 NOASSERTION）；商用多租户需另行获得商业许可。
